definitions.explanation: Milk that has been thickened by evaporating water and adding sugar. A sweet, thick white liquid commonly used as a topping for desserts.

examples.japanese: ⟦いちご→いちご：01028_ichigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{練乳|れんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I poured condensed milk on strawberries.

examples.japanese: ⟦かき{氷|ごおり}→かき氷：10300_kakigoori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{練乳|れんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like pouring lots of condensed milk on shaved ice.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{練乳|れんにゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧{二杯|にはい}⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: This dessert recipe requires two tablespoons of condensed milk.

notes:
A thick, sweet dairy product made by removing water from milk and adding sugar. In Japan, most commonly associated with strawberries and shaved ice (⟦かき{氷|ごおり}→かき氷：10300_kakigoori⟧).

ALTERNATE FORMS:
- Also written as ⟦コンデンスミルク→コンデンスミルク：27419_kondensumiruku⟧ (from English 'condensed milk')
- Informally called {練乳|れんにゅう} or れん⟦みるく→ミルク：00284_miruku⟧ in some regions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練乳|れんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to pour condensed milk on
- ⟦いちご→いちご：01028_ichigo⟧{練乳|れんにゅう}: strawberries with condensed milk
- {練乳|れんにゅう}{入|い}り: containing condensed milk
- ⟦{加糖|かとう}→加糖：20005_katou⟧{練乳|れんにゅう}: sweetened condensed milk (official term)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧{練乳|れんにゅう}: evaporated milk (unsweetened)
- ⟦{粉|こな}ミルク→粉ミルク：21060_konamiruku⟧: powdered milk / baby formula
- ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧: fresh cream
